proves.claim: parallelCheckout launches no git process and returns what git returns when GIT_CONFIG_COUNT carries three pairs that do not name checkout.workers.

cli.item-folder.config-count-no-launch.why: Without it, a claim run under GIT_CONFIG_COUNT would launch git config on every next and no test would notice.

proves.claim: parallelCheckout returns what git returns when a GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n pair sets checkout.workers, with no git launch.

cli.item-folder.config-count-sets-worker.why: Without it, reading past GIT_CONFIG_COUNT could ignore a pair that really sets checkout.workers and differ from git.
